title: Can I BEAT Explosive Magic?
summary: chess.com variant Explosive Magic (by BN1208): Atomic + King of the Hill + Spell Chess (5 Freeze spells, no Jump) on a 10x10 board with Dragon Bishops (B + lame N), a General (K+N) and Dragon Knights (lame N); torpedo pawns promote (B/N/Alfil/Dabbaba) on the rank behind the hill. Games vs humans up to CzarnyRes (~1930); a frozen king in check is mated.
rules: Atomic: a capture explodes the 3x3 area; pawns are not caught in explosions (0:01, 15:48).
King of the Hill: king on the 4 centre squares (e5 f5 e6 f6 on 10x10) wins (0:01, 1:11).
Spell Chess freeze: freeze a 3x3 area for one turn; 5 freezes per side, 3-turn cooldown, no jump spell (0:13, 5:13, 7:24, 19:11).
Dragon Bishop = bishop + non-jumping knight; General = king + knight; Dragon Knight = non-jumping knight (0:17).
Check exists: a frozen king in check is checkmate (2:19-2:34); castling exists (17:11).
Pawns can always double-step (torpedo) and promote on the rank directly behind the hill (frame text, 11:57; FEN4 pawnBaseRank 5 = 7th rank).
win_condition: Checkmate, explode the king, or reach the hill.
